news.titleEn: Trump Refuses Iran Truce Extension, Hormuz Standoff Raises Oil Prices
news.conclusionEn: President Trump said he will not extend the US-Iran ceasefire memorandum that expired Monday and threatened to "bomb" Oman if it interferes with US operations, sending Brent crude above $91 a barrel.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普宣布不再延长已于周一到期的美伊停火备忘录，并威胁若阿曼阻挠美方行动将「轰炸」阿曼，布伦特原油随之升破每桶91美元。
news.whyEn: The collapse of the truce raises the risk of renewed US-Israel-Iran military conflict and a prolonged standoff over the Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint for roughly a fifth of global oil supply, with direct implications for energy prices and inflation worldwide.
news.whyZh: 停火协议破裂加剧美以伊再度爆发军事冲突的风险，也令占全球约五分之一石油供应的霍尔木兹海峡僵局持续，直接冲击全球能源价格与通胀走势。
news.detailEn: Asked in the Oval Office whether he would seek an extension of the memorandum of understanding signed with Iran in mid-June, Trump said simply "no." The 60-day window it created for a lasting peace deal technically lapsed Monday, and the agreement had already been largely disregarded by both sides for weeks, with military operations resuming in the region since mid-July. Trump also threatened to "bomb" Oman if the Gulf state obstructed US operations near the Strait of Hormuz, where a standoff over shipping access has left talks deadlocked. Brent crude climbed above $91 a barrel and West Texas Intermediate traded near $85, both near multi-month highs, as traders priced in a longer disruption to Middle East energy flows.
news.detailZh: 在被问及是否会延长6月中旬与伊朗签署的谅解备忘录时，特朗普在椭圆形办公室简短回答「不会」。该协议原本为达成持久和平协议设定了60天窗口期，已于周一正式到期，而实际上双方数周来已基本无视协议内容，地区军事行动自7月中旬起便已恢复。特朗普还威胁称，若海湾国家阿曼阻挠美方在霍尔木兹海峡附近的行动，将对其实施「轰炸」，该海峡的航运准入僵局已令相关谈判陷入停滞。布伦特原油升破每桶91美元，西德克萨斯中质原油报每桶约85美元，均接近数月高位，交易员正为中东能源供应的长期中断风险定价。

news.titleEn: US Bond Selloff Drives 30-Year Yields to Highest Since 2007
news.conclusionEn: The yield on the 30-year US Treasury bond climbed to about 5.31% on August 17, its highest level since 2007, as heavy government debt issuance, sticky inflation and Middle East oil-price risk combined to push long-term borrowing costs to a near-two-decade high.
news.conclusionZh: 美国30年期国债收益率8月17日升至约5.31%，为2007年以来最高水平，政府发债规模庞大、通胀顽固及中东油价风险叠加，将长期借贷成本推至近20年新高。
news.whyEn: Rising long-term yields raise borrowing costs for mortgages, corporate debt and government financing across the economy, and the move reflects deepening investor anxiety about US fiscal deficits and inflation just as markets are also digesting an escalating Iran conflict.
news.whyZh: 长期收益率上升将推高全社会的房贷、企业债与政府融资成本，此番走势也反映出投资者对美国财政赤字与通胀的担忧持续加深，恰逢市场同时消化伊朗冲突升级的影响。
news.detailEn: The selloff was driven by several converging pressures: the US government continues to issue large volumes of debt to fund persistent budget deficits, requiring higher yields to attract buyers; inflation has proven stickier than the Federal Reserve hoped, with tariffs and rising energy costs keeping price pressures elevated; and oil prices above $90 a barrel amid the stalled US-Iran ceasefire have added further inflation risk. Heavy fundraising by AI infrastructure companies competing for capital in debt markets, along with softer demand for long-dated Treasuries, added additional upward pressure. Mortgage rates and other long-term borrowing costs are expected to track the move higher.
news.detailZh: 此轮抛售由多重因素交织推动：美国政府为填补持续的财政赤字持续大规模发债，需以更高收益率吸引买家；通胀顽固程度超出美联储预期，关税及能源成本上升持续推高物价压力；而美伊停火陷入僵局、油价升破每桶90美元，进一步加剧了通胀风险。此外，AI基础设施企业在债券市场大举融资与长期国债需求走弱，也带来额外上行压力。房贷利率及其他长期借贷成本预计将随之走高。

news.titleEn: Nvidia Backing $105 Billion in Financing for OpenAI Data Center in Ohio
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia will guarantee up to $105 billion in financing for a new SB Energy-built AI data center in Pike County, Ohio, with OpenAI as anchor tenant on a 20-year lease under the Stargate buildout.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达将为SB Energy在俄亥俄州派克县新建的AI数据中心提供最高1050亿美元的融资担保，OpenAI作为主力租户签下20年租约，纳入「星际之门」计划。
news.whyEn: The deal is one of the largest AI infrastructure financing commitments to date, illustrating the enormous capital scale now required to build out AI compute capacity and deepening Nvidia's financial entanglement with its biggest customer, OpenAI.
news.whyZh: 这是迄今为止规模最大的AI基础设施融资承诺之一，凸显了如今扩建AI算力所需的资本规模之庞大，也令英伟达与其最大客户OpenAI的财务关系进一步加深。
news.detailEn: A securities filing disclosed Monday that Nvidia will provide up to $105 billion in financing for the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus data center, which SB Energy will build and manage under a 20-year lease to OpenAI. The credit will support an initial 4.25 gigawatts of computing capacity, with an option to expand by another 3.75 gigawatts, and capacity is expected to come online in phases starting in 2028. Nvidia will separately invest $1.5 billion directly in SB Energy, while SB Energy and SoftBank plan to build power sources supporting 10 gigawatts of energy and invest at least $4.2 billion in regional grid infrastructure. OpenAI said the project will support 35,000 construction jobs through 2032 and 2,500 permanent positions.
news.detailZh: 一份周一披露的证券文件显示，英伟达将为PORTS-Pike科技园区数据中心提供最高1050亿美元融资，该数据中心由SB Energy建设运营，并与OpenAI签订20年租约。此笔信贷将支持初期4.25吉瓦的计算容量，并可选择再扩容3.75吉瓦，产能预计从2028年起分阶段上线。英伟达还将另外向SB Energy直接投资15亿美元，SB Energy与软银计划建设可支持10吉瓦电力的电源，并向区域电网基础设施投资至少42亿美元。OpenAI表示，该项目到2032年将带来3.5万个建筑岗位及2500个长期职位。

news.titleEn: Micron Falls 5%, SanDisk Sinks 6%, Western Digital Drops 7% as Higher Rates Test the Memory Boom
news.conclusionEn: Memory and storage chipmakers Micron, SanDisk and Western Digital slid sharply on August 18 as rising Treasury yields pressured the most-extended trade in the semiconductor sector, with a broader chip index down 5.5%.
news.conclusionZh: 受国债收益率飙升冲击，存储芯片股Micron、SanDisk及Western Digital8月18日大幅下挫，半导体板块整体指数下跌5.5%，此前该板块涨幅居前、估值偏高。
news.whyEn: The selloff signals that surging borrowing costs are now spilling over into the AI-driven chip rally that has powered much of this year's stock market gains, even though analysts see no change in underlying memory-chip demand or supply.
news.whyZh: 此次抛售显示借贷成本飙升已开始波及今年支撑股市大涨的AI芯片行情，尽管分析师认为存储芯片的实际供需基本面并未发生变化。
news.detailEn: Micron Technology fell about 5%, SanDisk sank 6% and Western Digital dropped 7% as memory and storage stocks led a broader semiconductor pullback, with a closely watched chip-sector gauge down 5.5% on the day. Analysts characterized the move as a valuation reset driven by the rising cost of capital rather than any deterioration in demand: higher Treasury yields raise the discount rate applied to future earnings, hitting hardest the stocks whose valuations depend most on distant growth, while also raising financing costs for the fabrication capacity Micron and Western Digital are building. Despite the one-day drop, all three stocks remain up sharply for the year, with Micron up 255%, SanDisk up 653% and Western Digital up 211% year-to-date through Monday's close.
news.detailZh: 存储芯片股领跌本轮半导体板块回调，Micron Technology下跌约5%，SanDisk重挫6%，Western Digital下跌7%，密切关注的芯片板块指数当日下跌5.5%。分析师将此轮下跌归因于资金成本上升带来的估值重估，而非需求端出现恶化：国债收益率上升会提高未来盈利的贴现率，对估值高度依赖远期增长的个股冲击最大，同时也推高了Micron、Western Digital正在扩建的晶圆产能的融资成本。尽管单日跌幅明显，但截至周一收盘，三只股票今年以来仍大幅上涨，Micron累计涨255%，SanDisk涨653%，Western Digital涨211%。

news.titleEn: Ukraine Launches One of Its Largest Aerial Attacks of the War, Killing at Least 6 People in Russia
news.conclusionEn: Ukraine launched one of its largest drone attacks of the war on August 16, sending hundreds of drones into Russia, including roughly 600 toward Moscow, killing at least six people and damaging homes, a railway station and energy infrastructure.
news.conclusionZh: 乌克兰8月16日发动战争以来最大规模无人机袭击之一，数百架无人机袭击俄罗斯，其中约600架飞向莫斯科方向，造成至少6人死亡，多处民宅、火车站及能源设施受损。
news.whyEn: The scale of the attack, described by Russian state media as the largest since the start of the year, signals a significant escalation in Ukraine's long-range strike campaign against Russian military and energy targets, raising the risk of a harsher Russian retaliatory response.
news.whyZh: 俄罗斯官方媒体称此次袭击规模为今年以来最大，标志着乌克兰对俄军事及能源目标的远程打击行动明显升级，也增加俄方展开更猛烈报复的风险。
news.detailEn: Russia said it shot down more than 800 Ukrainian drones overnight, with state-run TASS calling it the largest such attack since the start of the year. In Russia's southwestern Rostov region, more than 150 drones targeted three towns, killing five people and damaging homes, a railway station, and sparking a forest fire; an 83-year-old man was also killed when a drone hit a private home in the Moscow region. Roughly 600 drones were detected heading toward Moscow itself. Ukraine has increasingly targeted energy facilities and logistics hubs, including major warehouse depots, as part of a stepped-up campaign this year using long-range missiles and drone swarms against Russian military-industrial and energy infrastructure.
news.detailZh: 俄罗斯称一夜之间击落逾800架乌克兰无人机，俄官方媒体塔斯社称这是今年以来规模最大的一次此类袭击。在俄罗斯西南部罗斯托夫州，150余架无人机袭击了三座城镇，造成5人死亡，多处民宅及一座火车站受损，并引发森林火灾；莫斯科州一处民宅遭无人机击中，一名83岁老人身亡。另有约600架无人机被侦测到飞向莫斯科市区方向。今年以来，乌克兰持续加大对能源设施及大型物流仓储枢纽的打击力度，作为其对俄军工与能源基础设施远程导弹与无人机蜂群攻势升级的一部分。

news.titleEn: Home Depot Reaffirms Guidance Amid 'Frozen Housing Market Conditions'
news.conclusionEn: Home Depot beat quarterly estimates with revenue up 5.7% to $47.9 billion and comparable sales up 1.7%, while reaffirming full-year guidance despite describing housing market conditions as "frozen."
news.conclusionZh: Home Depot季度业绩超预期，营收同比增长5.7%至479亿美元，可比销售增长1.7%，公司维持全年业绩指引，但称当前住房市场处于「冻结」状态。
news.whyEn: As the largest US home improvement retailer, Home Depot's results are a closely watched barometer for consumer spending and the broader housing market, and its warning about frozen housing activity adds to signs that high borrowing costs are weighing on big-ticket household decisions.
news.whyZh: 作为美国最大家居建材零售商，Home Depot的业绩是观察消费支出与楼市走势的重要风向标，其对住房市场「冻结」的警示进一步印证高借贷成本正在抑制家庭大额消费决策。
news.detailEn: Home Depot reported fiscal second-quarter revenue of $47.9 billion, up 5.7% from a year earlier, with adjusted earnings per share rising 5.1% to $4.92, both ahead of Wall Street estimates. Comparable sales climbed 1.7%, beating the 0.9% consensus forecast, helped by resilient demand from professional contractors even as consumer-facing renovation spending stayed soft. Executives said elevated mortgage rates continue to discourage homeowners from listing or buying homes, freezing existing-home turnover and the larger renovation projects that typically follow a sale. Despite the tough housing backdrop, management reaffirmed its full-year sales and profit guidance, citing steady demand from professional customers and smaller discretionary projects.
news.detailZh: Home Depot公布截至该财季营收为479亿美元，同比增长5.7%，调整后每股收益增长5.1%至4.92美元，均超华尔街预期。可比销售增长1.7%，超过市场预期的0.9%，主要受益于专业承包商需求保持韧性，尽管面向普通消费者的装修支出仍显疲软。管理层表示，高企的房贷利率持续抑制房主挂牌出售或购房的意愿，导致二手房换手及随之而来的大型装修项目陷入「冻结」。尽管楼市环境严峻，管理层仍维持全年销售与利润指引，理由是专业客户需求及小型自主装修项目需求保持稳定。

news.titleEn: Tesla Prepares for Cybercab Launch in August, Starting With Rides to Employees
news.conclusionEn: Tesla is preparing to launch its steering-wheel-free Cybercab robotaxi in Austin as soon as this month, starting with rides for its own employees on public roads before folding the vehicles into its commercial robotaxi service.
news.conclusionZh: 特斯拉计划最快本月在奥斯汀推出无方向盘的Cybercab无人驾驶出租车，先在公共道路上向员工提供试乘服务，随后再将车辆纳入商业化Robotaxi车队。
news.whyEn: Cybercab is central to Tesla's bet on a driverless ride-hailing network and a key pillar of its valuation, so the pace and success of its public rollout will be closely watched by investors as a test of the company's autonomous-driving technology and regulatory standing.
news.whyZh: Cybercab是特斯拉押注无人驾驶出行网络的核心，也是其估值的重要支柱，此次公开落地的进度与成效将是投资者检验其自动驾驶技术及监管进展的关键节点。
news.detailEn: Tesla has told staff it aims to begin Cybercab rides on public roads in Austin this month, starting with employees before opening the service to the public days later, according to a report from The Information. The internal target is the end of August, though the timeline could slip and the regulatory status of commercial Cybercab service remains unclear. Preparation has included road testing, employee rides on private roads, and emergency-response training with Austin first responders. Cybercab was designed from the ground up for autonomous driving, with no steering wheel or pedals, distinguishing it from Tesla's existing Austin robotaxi fleet of roughly 186 Model Y vehicles that still rely on human safety monitors and modified full self-driving software.
news.detailZh: 据The Information报道，特斯拉已告知员工，计划本月在奥斯汀公共道路上启动Cybercab试乘，先面向内部员工，数日后再向公众开放服务。公司内部目标为8月底前落地，但时间表仍可能推迟，商业化Cybercab服务的监管状态也尚不明朗。此前准备工作包括道路测试、员工在私有道路上的试乘，以及与奥斯汀急救部门联合开展的应急响应培训。Cybercab从设计之初即面向全自动驾驶场景，取消了方向盘与踏板，这与特斯拉目前在奥斯汀运营、仍配备安全员并搭载改良版FSD软件的约186辆Model Y车队有本质区别。

businessTips.explanationEn: A network effect occurs when a product or service becomes more valuable to each user as more people use it — think of a marketplace, social platform, or payment network. This dynamic can create a powerful competitive moat, because a market leader with more users naturally attracts even more users, making it hard for smaller rivals to catch up even with a better product. The flip side is that network effects can work in reverse too: once users start leaving, the product becomes less useful for those who remain, which can trigger a rapid downward spiral.
businessTips.explanationZh: 网络效应是指一款产品或服务的使用者越多，它对每个用户的价值就越高——典型例子包括交易市场、社交平台或支付网络。这种动态能形成强大的竞争壁垒，因为用户越多的市场领先者会自然吸引更多新用户，使小竞争对手即便产品更优也难以追赶。但网络效应也可能反向运作：一旦用户开始流失，产品对留存用户的价值也随之下降，可能引发快速的连锁式衰退。
businessTips.exampleEn: A ride-hailing app becomes more useful to riders as more drivers join, because wait times shrink — and more riders in turn attracts more drivers chasing fares, letting the largest platform in a city keep out new entrants even if a challenger app takes a smaller commission.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一款打车软件的司机越多，乘客等车时间就越短，从而对乘客越有吸引力；而乘客越多又会吸引更多司机为抢单加入平台。这使得某座城市内规模最大的平台即便收取的抽成更高，也能有效阻挡收费更低的新竞争者进入。

businessTips.explanationEn: A minimum viable product is the simplest version of a new offering that still lets you test a core assumption with real customers, before investing time and money into building every feature you imagine it eventually needs. The goal isn't to launch something incomplete for its own sake, but to get real market feedback as cheaply and quickly as possible, so you can learn whether people actually want what you're building before committing serious resources. Many side-hustle founders skip this step and spend months polishing a product nobody has validated demand for.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最小可行产品（MVP）是指新产品或服务中最精简、但足以让你用真实客户验证核心假设的版本，目的是在投入大量时间和资金打造「设想中的完整功能」之前先行测试。MVP的意义不在于故意推出不完整的东西，而是要以最低成本、最快速度获得真实的市场反馈，从而判断人们是否真的需要你正在打造的产品，再决定是否投入更多资源。许多副业创业者会跳过这一步，花费数月打磨一款尚未验证过市场需求的产品。
businessTips.exampleEn: Instead of spending six months building a full mobile app for a meal-planning side business, a founder first sells the same weekly meal plans manually through a simple landing page and email list — if 50 people pay for it, that validates demand cheaply before any code gets written.
businessTips.exampleZh: 与其花六个月时间为一项餐食规划副业开发完整的手机App，创业者可以先通过一个简单的落地页和邮件订阅列表，人工提供同样的每周膳食计划——如果有50人愿意付费，就已经以极低成本验证了市场需求，之后再考虑投入开发。

businessTips.explanationEn: The P/E ratio divides a company's current share price by its earnings per share, giving a quick sense of how much investors are paying for each dollar of profit the company generates. A high P/E can mean the market expects strong future growth, or it can mean the stock is simply overpriced relative to its current earnings — the ratio alone doesn't tell you which. It's most useful when compared against a company's own historical average or against similar companies in the same industry, rather than viewed as an absolute good-or-bad number on its own.
businessTips.explanationZh: 市盈率（P/E）是用公司当前股价除以每股收益计算得出，能快速反映投资者为公司每一美元利润愿意支付多少价格。较高的市盈率既可能意味着市场预期公司未来会强劲增长，也可能只是股价相对当前盈利偏贵——单看这个数字本身并无法判断是哪一种。市盈率最有参考价值的用法，是与公司自身历史均值或同行业可比公司进行比较，而不是把它当作一个绝对的「好」或「坏」的标准来看待。
businessTips.exampleEn: Two software companies both trade at $50 a share, but one earns $1 per share (a P/E of 50) while the other earns $5 per share (a P/E of 10) — on that measure alone, the second looks cheaper relative to its current profits, though an investor would still need to check why the market is willing to pay so much more for each dollar the first company earns.
businessTips.exampleZh: 两家软件公司股价都是50美元，但一家每股收益为1美元（市盈率50倍），另一家每股收益为5美元（市盈率10倍）——仅从这个指标看，后者相对当前盈利显得更「便宜」，但投资者仍需进一步了解，为何市场愿意为前者每一美元的盈利支付高得多的价格。
